summary: Frontend-only verification after the QuizRunner.jsx docstring compile fix. Confirmed webpack/Babel compiles cleanly (supervisor frontend log: 'Compiled successfully', no 'Unterminated string constant'), grep shows no remaining Python triple-quoted strings in any .js/.jsx file, and /login returns HTTP 200 with the React app. Logged in with heatherprejean7325@gmail.com and E2E-tested QuizRunner, Employment Readiness, Journal (save+delete), Full Blueprint intake, Assessments hub+runner, 3 Doorways, DashboardV2, Bridge AI drawer, mobile bottom nav, and 8 regression routes. All flows passed; zero 4xx/5xx API responses observed post-login and no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Journal delete uses window.confirm(); consider a themed shadcn AlertDialog for consistency and for testability (window.confirm blocks automated flows unless dialogs are auto-accepted).
Doorway 'Back' uses nav(-1) (history back) — after a deep link it returns to the previous unrelated page; consider nav to the owning section as a fallback.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient journal entries prefixed TEST_ under the demo participant; submitted one workplace_expectations quiz attempt (0% failing attempt, used to exercise the retry path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified details: /app/quiz/workplace_expectations renders title 'Workplace expectations — knowledge check' with 5 MCQs; submit returns server-scored result panel (score %, per-question correct/wrong feedback with explanations), 'Try again' shown on fail and 'See my progress' always. /app/section/employment-readiness renders 10 items with progress badges (all NOT STARTED for demo user) and 'Take the quiz →' routes correctly. Journal: 5 mood buttons + VoiceInput mic (data-testid bridge-voice-btn); save and delete both persist (delete needs page.on('dialog', accept)). Intake: 'Immediate Needs', progress bar 'Section 1 of 13 · 13%', Yes/No/Unsure answers save silently. Assessments hub shows 4 cards; work_style runner shows 10 questions + submit. Doorways documents-ssn / recovery-wellness / living-housing all render Learn/Do/Track/Get help real content. Bridge drawer header 'Bridge AI', mic visible, placeholder 'Ask Bridge AI…'. Mobile 375x812 bottom nav shows Home | Blueprint | Assess | Library | Bridge AI. Only network non-2xx seen: 401 /api/auth/me on the unauthenticated login page (expected). NOTE: counting elements immediately after page load can race the entries fetch — add a wait.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: a Python triple-quoted docstring at the top of QuizRunner.jsx made Babel throw 'Unterminated string constant'. Fix (JSDoc /** ... */ block) is confirmed effective — frontend compiles and the quiz route works end to end.
